brand strings arrive ALL CAPS from Mestergull and title-case from David-Andersen/Bjørklund, so Georg Jensen, Efva Attling, Sif Jakobs, Pia & Per, Sylvsmidja and Eik barn each appear twice in the brand facet; Mestergull's Pia & Per is additionally HTML-entity-escaped ('PIA & PER')
notes: Category quality is good for real jewellery (272 of 300 rows are correctly Jewelry) and the damage is concentrated: 22 pieces of Mestergull silver cutlery plus 6 outright foreign rows (an aquarium fitting, a pool valve, napkin rings, a wooden stand, a picture frame, a book) rode in on shop floors over vague breadcrumbs, and 2 rows ('51', '52') are unusable scrape artefacts; facet coverage is the weaker half, with a systematic 'hvitt sølv'→Gold inversion, an inconsistent Anheng→Necklaces/Pendants split, and no Norwegian gemstone vocabulary; also worth noting outside the finding kinds, 149 of 300 rows (50%) have no product photo and NOT ONE row in the shard has more than a single offer, so this whole slice of the catalogue currently compares no prices at all.
